title: Across the Threshold — Living World
subtitle: A second world · powers · location lore

locations.name: Sanctuary
locations.description: A quiet chamber surrounds a well of light. Rest here to restore resonance. Beyond the arch lies a sealed threshold.

locations.name: Threshold
locations.description: A lattice of pale light blocks the path. Your attunement can loosen its pattern, but doing so costs three resonance.

exits.reason: Use Attune at the Threshold to break the seal.

locations.name: Observatory
locations.description: The sky is unfamiliar. A small compass rests beneath the window. Return it to the Warden to complete this test journey.

locations.name: Retreat
locations.description: A private place to pause as the next part of the day begins.

actors.name: Warden
actors.description: An adult keeper of the sanctuary.
examples: The gate remembers everyone who passes. It is in no hurry to forget you.
Rest, if you can. The night here is long, but it is not unkind.
actors.goal: See the lost compass safely returned.
actors.backstory: The Warden watches the threshold for changes in the sky.

facts.text: Attunement costs three resonance. Resting in the Sanctuary restores it.

abilities.name: Attune
abilities.result: The seal opens. Three resonance spent; the Observatory is now reachable.

quests.name: Return the star compass
quests.hint: Find the compass in the Observatory and give it to the Warden.

objects.name: Star map
objects.description: The etched constellations point toward a world you do not know.

objects.name: Inscribed arch
objects.description: Lines of pale light trace a sealed passage. Attunement can open it.

lorebook.text: The arch responds to resonance; attunement drains the traveller but opens the passage.
The Observatory records constellations from a distant sky.

daypart.event: The sky beyond the arch is shifting.

hangouts.plan: Study the changing sky with the Warden
